titulo_ja: おどろき と けっか (2)
titulo_es: Finally, in the end and indeed:

texto: To say that something comes after a wait or a long effort: **やっと しけん が おわった** (finally finished the exam).
It is used when the expected has cost.
To mark that something finally happened after a wait: **ついに ゆめ が かなった** (my dream was finally fulfilled). It can be used in positive or negative results.
To say that something ended up happening after a process or a wait: **とうとう にほん へ いく こと に なりました** (it was finally decided that he would go to Japan). The tone depends on the context.

frases.en: A dream of many years was finally fulfilled. The preparation was hard, but I continued to the end. When the presentation was over, my family brought me flowers.
